items: 【Outdoor Patio Furniture Cover Waterproof 4-Piece Set】The innovative independent design divides the traditional lawn/patio furniture cover into four separate ones. Even if one gets damaged, you still have three others available. Installation can be easily completed by one person alone. Each cover can snugly protect one piece of furniture. Package contains: 2 x patio/lawn chair covers 32"L x 30"W x 30"H, 1 x loveseat cover 56"L x 30"W x 30"H, 1 x patio coffee table cover 45"L x 25"W x 13"H.

【600D Tear-Resistant Material】Heavy duty patio furniture cover are crafted from robust 600D oxford cloth, boasting remarkable toughness and tear - resistance. These UV-resistant patio furniture covers for patio tables and patio chairs safeguard your outdoor conversation sets round - the - year against natural wear and tear, as well as external elements such as sunlight, dirt, rain,strong winds and snow.

【Waterproof Outdoor Patio Furniture Cover 】STARTWO 4 - piece patio set covers exhibit outstanding waterproof capabilities. They keep your patio loveseats,patio chairs and patio coffe tables completely dry, even during heavy rainstorms. Crafted with a PU waterproof back - coating and featuring waterproof sealing tape on the inner seams, these patio furniture covers are engineered to ensure that water cannot penetrate your furniture.

【Windproof Buckles Design】No need to worry about the 4 - piece outdoor patio furniture covers being blown away! Each patio furniture cover is equipped with four windproof buckle straps at the legs. These straps ensure exceptional stability even on the windiest days. Additionally, an adjustable drawstring is provided, enabling you to achieve a snug and customized fit at the bottom of the patio furniture covers.

【STARTWO Patio Furniture Covers】We're dedicated to crafting top - notch outdoor patio furniture covers. These covers shield your patio furniture from dirt, debris, water accumulation, intense sunlight, and all the elements nature might throw its way.
